Name: Pumpkin Head - Custom Trinket
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][color=#ff7700][size=5][font=Trebuchet MS][u][b]Pumpkin Head Custom Trinket[/b][/u][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]

[size=4]This is a small lightweight Halloween companion mod for Stardew Valley!

Meet Morte, a talking jack-o'-lantern accidentally brought to life by the Wizard while attempting to make Spirit's Eve decorations.

Sarcastic and spooky, Morte accompanies you on your adventures, cracks terrible Halloween jokes, and makes monster hunting a little sweeter![/size]

[b][u][size=5]Features[/size][/u][/b]

[size=4]- A New Trinket: Morte hops alongside the farmer like a little pumpkin companion. [/size]

[size=4]-Passive buff: When equipped, Morte provides a +1 Luck buff.

- Bad Jokes: Enjoy over 100+ Halloween dad jokes, spooky remarks, pumpkin puns, and trivia.

- Trick or Treat! Defeated monsters have a chance to drop one of six custom candies in addition to their normal loot.

- Sweet Rewards: Each candy restores 75 Health and 75 Energy and grants +1 Luck for three in-game hours.

- Halloween Bonus: Candy drops are guaranteed during the final week of Fall (Fall 22–28).

- Wizard's Gift: Receive Morte through a special letter from the Wizard once you've unlocked the trinket slot.[/size]

[b][u][size=5]Configuration[/size][/u][/b]

[size=4]Enable Candy Drops: Enable or disable bonus candy drops.

Immediate Wizard Gift: Receive Morte as soon as you're eligible, without waiting for Fall

Dialogue Settings: Adjust how frequently Morte speaks.[/size]

[b][u][size=5]Requirements[/size][/u][/b]

[size=4]-SMAPI
-Stardew Valley 1.6[/size]
